name: toolshare

scripts.install-all: npm install && npm install --prefix server && npm install --prefix client
scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c green,cyan "npm run dev --prefix server" "npm run dev --prefix client"
scripts.build: npm install --prefix client && npm run build --prefix client

description: ToolShare India: a MERN app to borrow tools from neighbours and lend what you own.
author: Prabhat Yadav
